description: This file contains abstract base class for testing silo liveness detection and membership management in Orleans, along with a derived test class that includes specific test cases related to membership grain behavior and silo lifecycle management in a Orleans cluster.

classes.name: LivenessTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for performing silo liveness and membership tests in Orleans, providing methods to simulate silo failures, restarts, and validate cluster health.

classes.name: LivenessTests_MembershipGrain
classes.description: Concrete test class extending LivenessTestsBase, implementing specific test cases related to membership grain and silo lifecycle management with custom client configuration.

methods.name: Do_Liveness_OracleTest_1
methods.description: Tests proper handling of silo shutdown and status updates within the cluster.

methods.name: Do_Liveness_OracleTest_2
methods.description: Tests cluster behavior during silo restart, kill, and subsequent communication with grains.

methods.name: Do_Liveness_OracleTest_3
methods.description: Tests behavior when stopping and restarting silos in sequence, ensuring continued cluster operation.

methods.name: TestTraffic
methods.description: Simulates grain calls to verify cluster responsiveness after silo operations.

methods.name: SendTraffic
methods.description: Performs a grain call with a specified key, optionally starting timers on the grain.

methods.name: LogGrainIdentity
methods.description: Logs details about a grain's identity and runtime information.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Method to configure the test cluster with specific options, overridden in derived classes.
